articles.title: Bryce splash!
articles.summary: Bryce Eldridge, a player for the San Francisco Giants, achieved a significant career milestone in 2026 by hitting his first-ever 'splash hit' home run. This marked the team's inaugural splash hit of the season and the 109th such event in McCovey Cove's history, where the ball lands in the icy Bay waters, signifying a remarkable achievement in baseball.

articles.title: Kikkoman Revamps its Dark Soy Sauce Exclusively for the Indian Market
articles.summary: Kikkoman is relaunching its Dark Soy Sauce, specially refined for the Indian market, as announced from New Delhi on July 10, 2026. This updated product, initially developed for India, has undergone further enhancements. The initiative highlights Kikkoman's focus on catering to the unique culinary preferences of Indian consumers with a specially formulated condiment, strengthening its presence in the national market.

articles.title: Scientists Identify 73 Previously Unknown Underwater Volcanoes
articles.summary: Researchers have discovered 73 previously unknown volcanic calderas on the ocean floor. This significant finding was made possible using an innovative algorithm initially designed to locate impact craters on Mars. This interdisciplinary application highlights advancements in mapping unexplored underwater terrains, deepening our understanding of Earth's complex geological processes and potential hazards.

articles.title: India ramps up missile sales in Indo-Pacific as China’s assertiveness turns neighbors wary
articles.summary: India is set to supply its advanced BrahMos and Astra missiles to Indonesia, marking its third such defense agreement in the Indo-Pacific region. This significant deal underscores New Delhi's rapidly growing prominence as a reliable defense supplier and exporter in the region. It highlights India's strategic intent to strengthen partnerships and its evolving role amid increasing geopolitical complexities, boosting its defense manufacturing capabilities.

articles.title: Prashant Jain, other top investors pick Rs 1,655 crore stake in SBI Funds Management pre-IPO deals
articles.summary: SBI Funds Management, India's largest asset management company and an arm of State Bank of India, is preparing for a stock market listing. This significant move, backed by strong institutional support and a substantial capital raise, signals a major development within India's financial sector. It underscores growing market confidence and highlights the robust health of key Indian economic institutions, which is a positive indicator for national economic stability.

articles.title: CNA Explains: Why China's rare missile test is putting the Pacific on edge
articles.summary: China possesses Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) capability, which is continuously evolving. While China has had this strategic capability for some time, its submarine fleet traditionally trails behind the advanced naval powers of the US and Russia. This indicates China's ongoing efforts to modernize its undersea warfare and strategic deterrent capabilities.

articles.title: German energy supplier Meteoric unveils sci-fi inspired rebrand
articles.summary: German energy supplier Meteoric has unveiled a new brand identity, created by agency How&How. Meteoric aims to disrupt the European mid-market with its unique, science fiction-inspired energy proposition. This strategic rebranding signifies Meteoric's ambition to become a significant player in the competitive European energy landscape, leveraging innovative marketing to stand out.

articles.title: Forty years after Anzus blow-up, New Zealand is ready to build new alliances — Thomas Coughlan
articles.summary: A new defence deal establishes a mutual obligation for parties to consult and potentially act on security threats. This agreement covers developments that could threaten the sovereignty, peace, or stability of any signatory. It signifies a commitment to collective security, ensuring coordinated responses to emergent challenges and bolstering regional stability through unified defence strategies.

articles.title: How Beijing 'tripled the size of its nuclear arsenal' in six years
articles.summary: China recently launched an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) with a dummy warhead into the Pacific, alarming countries worldwide. This demonstration of advanced long-range strike capability raises significant concerns about regional stability and China's expanding military power. Such developments underscore evolving geopolitical tensions and the importance of international dialogue on strategic arms control and security.

articles.title: Can Indo-Pacific Powers Deter China Without the US?
articles.summary: The US reverted its military command's name from Indo-Pacific to Pacific Command, reversing a 2018 decision that emphasized India's strategic role and a broader regional focus against China. This change signals a potential recalibration of US strategic priorities, possibly narrowing its regional emphasis or re-evaluating India's centrality, impacting regional geopolitics and security dynamics.

articles.title: Joanna Pettet Dead: 'The Group,' 'Casino Royale' Actress Was 83
articles.summary: Veteran actress Joanna Pettet, known for her roles in Sidney Lumet’s 'The Group' and the 1967 spoof 'Casino Royale', has passed away. The London-born star famously played a Vassar graduate and, notably, a spy alongside David Niven’s James Bond. Her death marks the end of an era for a performer who contributed to significant films of her time, impacting international cinema.
